facts.fact: The UNDP assessment says Madagascar's national digital strategy is 'formalised' and anchored to the Politique Générale de l'État, and that it is in implementation (a consolidation phase); it names no adopting act, no body that adopted it and no approval date, and uses none of approved, adopted, enacted or gazetted, so the value follows the D3 rule; the report's December 2025 publication date is used.

UNDP names the Plan Stratégique Numérique 2023-2028, aligned with the Politique Générale de l'État and the SDGs, as Madagascar's national digital strategy, covering modernisation of the state, public services, digital agriculture, financial inclusion and digital identity; no as-of date is given for the period, so the report's December 2025 publication date is used.

UNDP cites targets in the plan: the digital sector at 6% of GDP in 2028 (1.5% in 2019), 80% network coverage and progressive 5G by 2028, 664,000 connected devices of which 400,000 for women and girls, and a gap of 40,000 specialists to fill; the report states no cost for the plan (report December 2025).

UNDP states the plan is placed under the coordination of the digital ministry (MNDPT), which ensures coherence and strategic supervision, supported by the Unité de Gouvernance Digitale attached to the Presidency; 79% of surveyed experts confirm dedicated structures exist but only 21% judge them fully operational (report December 2025).

UNDP reports that 86% of surveyed experts say digital budgets are specific to and limited by project, none mentions a general or lasting allocation, and all point to almost no funding beyond a project's initial cycle; it ties no budget line to the plan (report December 2025).

note: Read whole, 123 pages. The report states no adopting act for the PSN, so standing follows the D3 rule; it quotes the plan by page (pp. 9, 12, 16, 21, 47, 68, 70) but gives no link and does not say the plan's text is published, so no text fact. No published government progress report against the plan's targets is described (the 7% figure is an expert survey), so no reporting fact.
